name: Zot OpenClaw Telemetry
description: Connected traces, token/cost rollups, content capture, and metrics for OpenClaw via OpenTelemetry

protocol.label: OTLP Protocol
protocol.help: Use 'http' for OTLP/HTTP (port 4318) or 'grpc' for OTLP/gRPC (port 4317).

headers.label: OTLP Headers
headers.help: Custom headers for OTLP export (e.g. Authorization for a hosted backend).

heartbeat.label: Enable Heartbeat Spans
heartbeat.help: Subscribe to the heartbeat bus and emit one openclaw.heartbeat.run span per emitted tick. Off by default.

captureContent.label: Capture Prompt/Completion Content
captureContent.help: true/false (all-on or all-off) or a granular ContentCapturePolicy with per-category flags inputMessages, outputMessages, toolInputs, toolOutputs, systemPrompt. Default is everything off. No redaction is applied.

sampleRate.label: Trace Sampling Rate
sampleRate.help: Optional head-based sampling rate from 0.0 to 1.0.

endpoint.description: OTLP endpoint URL (e.g. http://localhost:4318 for HTTP, http://localhost:4317 for gRPC). Defaults to $OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, then localhost.

heartbeat.description: Subscribe to the OpenClaw heartbeat bus and emit openclaw.heartbeat.run spans (default off).

captureContent.description: Content capture policy. true/false toggles every category; an object selects categories individually. Default everything off. No redaction is applied.

sampleRate.description: Optional head-based trace sampling rate from 0.0 to 1.0
